data.summary: The figures I checked match Microsoft's reported fiscal 2024 results: revenue of $245.1B (vs. $211.9B in FY2023), net income of $88.1B, operating income of $109.4B, total assets of $512.2B, and cash and cash equivalents of about $18.3B. Your note said the revenue growth percentage was already verified, so I left it out of this review.
